Railway Division Restructuring in Mangaluru Sparks Financial Concerns

Railway officials are scheduled to meet in Mangaluru this week to discuss the transfer of assets and operational responsibilities as the Mangaluru Railway Region transitions. The Palakkad railway division is projected to lose approximately ₹650 crore annually as a result of this restructuring, with the Mangaluru region shifting its alignment to the Mysuru division. Divisional heads and officers will convene to manage the operational and asset handover.
